3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: In a few seconds, the convoy came to a graceful stop in front of the steps of the House. Titus held the door for me as I stepped out.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: As I ascended the stairs, the doors swung open, revealing the bare-bones interior of the House. A chamber that my father was forced to form, now ready to script a new chapter with my support.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I stepped onto the podium as loud applause echoed around me, the faces of the delegates alight with the promise of the future.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: When the hall fell silent, I took a deep breath.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: When I joined the crowd of people gathered inside the building, I was immediately greeted by Manus and Daria, who took me to the ministerial chambers.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: Followed by security, we entered the room. The new constitution of Rizia had been laid out on a table in the center.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: As we exchanged handshakes and formalities with each other, Manus leaned in and whispered in my ear.

14.speaker: Manus Sazon
14.text: "Not a word from the nobles. Seems like everything is going according to plan."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: My aides guided me to the table, pulled out a chair for me and carried over a large leather box with golden etchings.

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: After I was seated, two aides opened the box and held it out for me. Inside, a single pen was cushioned in red velvet.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: Journalists began snapping photos as soon as I grabbed the pen. Everyone looked at me in excitement as they waited for my signature.

25.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
25.text: Sign the constitution without saying anything.

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "This delegation of legislative control -- this DLC -- has been a long time coming. I hope it lives up to all of your expectations."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "Today, we entrust our future to the hands of those elected to represent Rizia. It's a bold step, but one I believe is right."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "You must understand it is very difficult for me to sign this and willingly transfer my powers away. It's a bold step, but one that must be taken."

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: The room broke into applause as I signed the documents.

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: That was it. With my signature, the new constitution was in place.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: After a long pause, I stood up. My next step was to declare the constitution in public and appoint Rizia's new head of government.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: I gave no thought to the significance of what I had just done. Instead, the simplicity of the process made me feel nervous -- as if I expected someone to have intervened.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: Daria and Manus guided me through the corridors of the parliament towards the main hall.

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: Before we entered inside, the aides handed me a ceremonial silk sash with blue and golden stripes, to be presented to the first prime minister.

39.speaker: Daria de Rava
39.text: "I will not let you or the Kingdom down, Your Majesty."

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Actually, Ms. De Rava... I have decided to appoint Manus instead. I believe this is for the best."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "Actually, Manus... I have decided to appoint Ms. Rava instead. I believe this is for the best."

53.speaker: Daria de Rava
53.text: "What is the meaning of this? You can't do that, Your Majesty."

54.speaker: Daria de Rava
54.text: "I thought this constitution is supposed to reflect the will of the Rizian people."

55.speaker: Manus Sazon
55.text: "When did you decide on that, Your Majesty?"

56.speaker: Manus Sazon
56.text: "I wish my party had been included in that conversation."

57.speaker: Daria de Rava
57.text: "I wish my party had been included in that conversation."

58.speaker: Manus Sazon
58.text: "This does not reflect the will of the people."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "I've respected the will of the people enough today. As the monarch, I will appoint Daria as the prime minister. End of discussion."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "We are about to enter the hall, Manus. Please keep your act down."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "Madam de Rava was an integral figure in passing these reforms. I promised her she would be rewarded, and I am keeping that promise."

63.speaker: Player_Romus
63.text: "I've respected the will of the people enough today. As the monarch, I will appoint Manus as the prime minister. End of discussion."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "We are about to enter the hall, Daria. Please keep your act down."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "There was no conversation. As the monarch, I will appoint whoever I want."

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: Suddenly, the aides opened the doors and we entered the hall. Massive cameras were filming us as we walked inside.

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Today, we stand at the dawn of a new era in the history of our nation."

72.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
72.text: Wait for the applause to stop.

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "It is with a heart full of hope and a mind conscious of the demands of the democratic movement that I address you on this momentous occasion."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "It is with a heart full of hope and a mind conscious of the demands of a new constitution made by the people, that I address you on this momentous occasion."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "Today, we reaffirm our unwavering commitment to the principles that are the bedrock of any great society—participation in politics, liberty, and the rule of law."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "In the spirit of our timeless principles, I stand before you, not as a ruler, but as a fellow Rizian."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "On this historic day, we are reminded of the enduring legacy of our kingdom—a legacy rich in tradition and bound by the unbreakable spirit of these lands."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I believe Rizia was in need of a constitution that reflects our collective aspirations for a just, equitable, and democratic society."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Change, as we know, is the only constant in the march of time. It is the harbinger of progress, the catalyst for innovation, and the doorway to new possibilities."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Embracing change is not just an option; it is our imperative if we are to stride confidently into the future that beckons us."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Throughout the ages, our beloved country has been guided by the steady hand of the monarchy, a lineage that has weathered the storms of time."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "Yet, the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "Because the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "And the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "The world around us is changing. Nations are awakening to the clarion call of freedom and representation, recognizing that the true strength of a country lies in the collective will of its citizens."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "It is in this light that I, your monarch, have resolved to embrace the winds of change."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "Therefore, I decided to give my support to the democratic movement in drafting a new constitution for Rizia."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "With this in mind, we all must give a solemn pledge to ensure that the voice of every citizen is heard, and the rights of every individual are protected."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "By establishing a head of government and vesting legislative powers in this House, the people, we are not just reforming our governance. We are fixing it."

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: As soon as I said that, the aides brought the constitution and displayed it to the delegates, prompting more applause.

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "We are gathered here, not to witness the diminishing of the crown, but to celebrate the empowerment of the people."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "We are establishing, for the first time in our history, the office of the Prime Minister, a head of government chosen from among the representatives of the people, to lead the executive branch with diligence and integrity."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "In embracing these reforms, I am mindful of the profound responsibility that comes with leadership -- the responsibility to put the welfare of the nation and its people above all else."

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "It is a responsibility that I embrace not with a sense of loss, but with the deepest sense of honor and purpose."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "I embrace this evolution, not as a departure from our cherished traditions, but as an affirmation of their enduring relevance. This constitution does not signify an end but a beginning -- a harmonious blending of the old and the new."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "This act of endorsing this constitution is about ensuring that the legacy we leave for future generations is one of a society that values dialogue over decree, consensus over command, and the common good over individual gain."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "This House will be the crucible in which the laws of our land are forged, ensuring that every statute reflects the collective will of the Rizian people."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: In consenting to this constitution, I do not relinquish my love for this country; rather, I reaffirm my commitment to serve it and its people with every fiber of my being."

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "Let the pages of history remember this day as the moment when we chose not just to change, but to evolve; not just to promise, but to deliver; not just to dream, but to achieve."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "As we chart this new course, let us be guided by the democratic principles that are now enshrined in our constitution."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "At this moment, I am reminded that true leadership is not about wielding power; it is about empowering others."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "Honorable delegates, I now entrust my power to you, the elected voice of our people."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "With the power vested in me by tradition and lineage, I declare the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law -- adopting a true constitutional monarchy."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "I hereby announce that the new constitution was signed and is currently in place."

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: I held up the silk sash for everyone to see.

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "In this spirit of renewal and with the power vested in me, I hereby announce the appointment of the new head of government..."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "In accordance with the new constitution, I shall appoint a new head of government until the elections..."

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "In appointing a new head of government, we turn a page in our history, embracing a governance of the people, by the people."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "As for the first Prime Minister of Rizia... This individual is someone who embodies the principles we hold dear and possesses the vision to lead our nation into a promising future..."

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: The room hung on my every word, the air thick with anticipation.

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "I appoint Manus Sazon as interim Prime Minister."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "I appoint Daria de Rava as interim Prime Minister."

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: A murmur of disapproval rippled through the chamber as he made his way to the podium.

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: Manus rose from his seat among the delegates, his expression one of determination.

134.speaker: Narrator
134.text: Daria rose from her seat among the delegates, her expression one of surprise and excitement.

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: Daria rose from her seat among the delegates, her expression one of confidence.

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: A murmur of disapproval rippled through the chamber as she made her way to the podium.

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: A murmur of approval rippled through the chamber as he made his way to the podium.

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: A murmur of approval rippled through the chamber as she made her way to the podium.

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "To the future -- a future that we will build together, on the solid foundation of this new charter."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "God bless Rizia, and long live the Kingdom."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "May the bonds that unite us as a people grow ever stronger, and may our nation flourish under the guiding principles of this new constitution."

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: I put the sash and the pin on him.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: I put the sash and the pin on her.

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: Another round of applause broke out -- this time for much longer.

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Another round of applause broke out -- this time for much longer.

157.speaker: Manus Sazon
157.text: "Your Majesty, delegates, and fellow citizens, I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me. This is a momentous day for democracy and liberty."

158.speaker: Manus Sazon
158.text: "I am proud to have represented the democratic movement to this day, and I am overjoyed to see such a transfer of power finally take place."

159.speaker: Manus Sazon
159.text: "Our path forward will be built on dialogue, on the collective wisdom of this assembly, and on the aspirations of our people."

160.speaker: Daria de Rava
160.text: "Your Majesty, delegates, and fellow citizens, I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me. This is a momentous day, not only for me, but for our great kingdom."

161.speaker: Daria de Rava
161.text: "Together, we will embark on a journey of transformation, grounded in the principles of tradition, equity, and prosperity for all."

162.speaker: Daria de Rava
162.text: "We will face challenges, no doubt, but in our unity, we will find strength."

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: The delegates rose in a standing ovation.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: The delegates rose in a standing ovation.

167.speaker: Manus Sazon
167.text: "I promise to represent the interests of the Rizian people -- regardless of their economic or cultural backgrounds and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

168.speaker: Manus Sazon
168.text: "I swear that I will serve my duty with diligence until the upcoming elections, when Rizia will finally elect their own government."

169.speaker: Daria de Rava
169.text: "I promise to represent the interests of the Rizian people and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

170.speaker: Daria de Rava
170.text: "I swear that I will serve my duty to the Crown with diligence until the upcoming elections."

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: After taking the applause in, together, we walked towards the balcony to face the crowd that had gathered outside.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: It was done. My signature, the House approval and now a broadcast declaration. It was a point of no return.

183.speaker: Daria de Rava
183.text: "What you're doing is nepotism. Pure and simple."

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: When I joined the crowd of people gathered inside the building, I was immediately greeted by Adarfo Sotelato, who took me to the ministerial chambers.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: Followed by security, we entered the room. The new constitution of Rizia had been laid out on a table in the center.

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: As we exchanged handshakes and formalities with each other, Adarfo leaned in and whispered in my ear.

210.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
210.text: "Glad you made it. I half-expected you to backtrack at the last minute."

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: Adarfo guided me through the corridors of the parliament towards the main hall.

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: Before we entered inside, the aides handed me a ceremonial silk sash with blue and golden stripes, to be presented to the first prime minister.

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: Adarfo quickly snatched the sash from me.

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: Suddenly, he rushed towards the doors and entered the hall without waiting for me.

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: He immediately stepped onto the podium and displayed his ceremonial sash as massive cameras filmed him.

223.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
223.text: "I hereby announce that His Majesty, King Romus Toras, has signed the Constitution and appointed me as the Prime Minister of Rizia!"

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "Mr. Sotelato! I have yet to officially appoint you."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Let me go immediately and I'll forget this happened."

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: Suddenly, the hall broke into massive applause.

232.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
232.text: "Today, we stand at the dawn of a new era in the history of our nation."

233.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
233.text: "I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me in overseeing this revolutionary change."

234.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
234.text: "I am proud to have represented the common people of Rizia, and I am overjoyed to see such a transfer of power finally take place."

235.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
235.text: "Our path forward will be built on great transformations and reversal of historical injustices, all for the benefit of the Rizian people."

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: The RPP delegates rose in a standing ovation.

237.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
237.text: "I promise to fight for the interests of the Rizian working class, and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

238.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
238.text: "I swear that I will serve my duty with diligence until the upcoming elections, when the citizens of Rizia will finally elect their own government."

240.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
240.text: "According to this new constitution, the nobility will no longer have any power nor privilege over the governance of this country."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "Circumstances have changed, Mr. Sazon. The only way to pass these reforms was to guarantee Baroness De Rava the position of Prime Minister."

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: I stepped onto the podium as the RPP delegates burst into applause. Those from the RNC were pointedly silent.

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: I stepped onto the podium to a round of applause from the delegates. Some appeared hopeful for the future; others wore fearful expressions.

253.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
253.text: Wait for the applause to stop.

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "This speech is not mine to give. Having signed away my powers as monarch, I will now yield the floor to Rizia's new head of government."
